znr.text: Akiri is a kor line-slinger and veteran of Sea Gate, sent with Zareth to follow rumors of a fallen hedron up the Umara River Gorge, where Zareth apologizes for leaving Sea Gate and she welcomes him home.
When they find only a strange pool, Akiri refuses Zareth's suggestion to slip away from the secret Skyclave expedition to Murasa, insisting on fixing Zendikar and creating power for its people.
Nahiri pitches her party on retrieving the Lithoform Core, claiming it will heal Zendikar, and Akiri's party agrees to depart at first light.
On the Magosi Steps, Akiri leaps off the switchback to fight the giant serpent Verazol and saves Zareth by catching his hand with her line as the beast devours the caravan above.
